constraints.description: No choke-point transit without overwatch in fog <200m
Route risk capacity under ISR cover

goals.description: Deliver >=90% medical cargo intact before SLA

blue_r1.what: Push Highway 9 immediately with standard escort — shortest path to beat SLA
blue_r1.rationale: Naive Blue plan prioritizes speed over fog overwatch.

red_r1.description: Fog thickens at choke-point; ISR overwatch unavailable for 6 hours
red_r1.rationale: Hard must_not: transit without overwatch in dense fog. Capacity/risk blows past cover.

blue_r2.what: Patch: divert to Ridge Road with drone overwatch + fuel contingency; hold choke until visibility OK
blue_r2.rationale: Blue patches Red kill shot — avoids choke without overwatch, spends contingency within budget.

red_r2.description: Secondary delay on Ridge Road increases fuel burn but overwatch remains online
red_r2.rationale: Stresses cost/SLA but does not re-break the hard must_not.

blue_r3.what: Final patch: pre-position fuel cache + stagger trucks to keep SLA buffer >= 5h
blue_r3.rationale: Locks in survivor branch with SLA margin and budget headroom.

red_r3.description: Attempted false overwatch spoof — detected by checklist
red_r3.rationale: Red probes deception; ConstraintCheck + procedures hold.

baseline: ONE-SHOT BASELINE (no graph, no Red team): Proceed on Highway 9 immediately with standard escort. Fog is temporary; shortest path maximizes SLA probability. Budget $22k. Confidence: high. (Brittle — ignores hard overwatch constraint under fog.)

memo.title: Recommend Ridge Road patched convoy
memo.recommended_reason: Survivor branch avoids the fog choke must_not kill shot, stays inside $85k after contingency, and preserves SLA buffer. Highway-9 speed run is dead.
memo.kill_shots: R1 Red: fog + no overwatch at choke-point falsified the naive Highway 9 push (hard must_not / capacity cover).
memo.open_risks: Ridge secondary delay and fuel burn; residual ISR spoof risk is low but non-zero.
memo.dissent: Speed-first officers still prefer Highway 9; Arbiter rejects because Red proved the hard constraint break on that line.
